hidapi 0.15.0 (https://github.com/libusb/hidapi, tag hidapi-0.15.0, commit
d6b2a974608dec3b76fb1e36c189f22b9cf3650c), used under its BSD licence
(hidapi is offered under the GPL v3, a BSD-style licence or the original
HIDAPI licence, at the user's choice; see LICENSE.txt and LICENSE-bsd.txt).
Only hidapi/hidapi.h and windows/hid.c with the windows/hidapi_*.h headers
and windows/hidapi_descriptor_reconstruct.c (which hid.c includes) are
kept, unchanged.  hidapitest.exe (userland/programs/hidapitest.c, the
devices self-test boot "hid") builds the Windows backend against NovaOS's
own SDK headers to check that NovaOS gives it what Windows does: the HID
interface list, hid.dll and the device interface and device node
properties (cfgmgr32) it reads to tell USB, Bluetooth, I2C and SPI devices
apart.
